ImageDescription.value:
This is a transcription of a clavichord record by Joan Benson (Bridge S 2250). It was a "recommended recording of the year" (1973) by the Saturday Review. This recording is on clavichords by Thomas Goff of England and Jacobus Verwolf of the Netherlands. To appear later will be selections on historical

instruments: a 1568 Tosi, and 1796 Schiedmayer.

Permission.value: The license information states that this file is "available for free download subject to the EFF OAL" (Open Audio License), which in turn is interchangeable with the CC-BY-SA-2.0.
